name: Mike Johnson for Logan City Council
description: Mike Johnson is a Logan, Utah small business owner and the 2026 Chair of the Logan Municipal Council, running for re-election in 2027. He focuses on attainable housing, responsible budgets, safe streets and traffic, parks and trails, local jobs, and long-term planning for Logan.
